hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Western Africa, north of Ghana || mostly flat to dissected, undulating plains; hills in the west and southeast; occupies an extensive plateau with savanna that is grassy in the north and gradually gives way to sparse forests in the south || landlocked savanna cut by the three principal rivers, the Black, Red, and White Voltas || Resources: gold, manganese, zinc, limestone, marble, phosphates, pumice, salt || Exports: gold, cotton, oil seeds, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews, cement (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly flat to dissected, undulating plains; hills in the west and southeast; occupies an extensive plateau with savanna that is grassy in the north and gradually gives way to sparse forests in the south || Western Africa, north of Ghana

climate.excerpt: three climate zones including a hot tropical savanna with a short rainy season in the southern half, a tropical hot semi-arid steppe climate typical of the Sahel region in the northern half, and small area of hot desert in the very north of the country bordering the Sahara Desert || recurring droughts

economy.excerpt: highly agrarian, low-income economy; limited natural resources; widespread poverty; terrorism disrupting potential economic activity; improving trade balance via increases in gold exports; economy inflating after prior deflation; growing public debt but still manageable || Exports: gold, cotton, oil seeds, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews, cement (2023) || Industries: cotton lint, beverages, agricultural processing, soap, cigarettes, textiles, gold
